# Evergreen Office Cleaning

> Commercial and office cleaning in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area since 1989: recurring after-hours janitorial contracts, building maintenance and floor care, and one-off specialty cleaning for offices, clinics, managed buildings, retail and industrial sites.

- Address: 243 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1Z4, Canada
- Phone: (416) 803-4880
- Email: info@evergreencleaningservice.ca
- Office hours: Monday to Friday 7am–6pm, closed weekends. Cleaning itself is done after hours and at weekends. One office; crews travel to clients across the service area.
- Founded: 1989. Formerly known as Evergreen Cleaning Service.
- Areas served: Toronto (including North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, East York and York), Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Pickering, Ajax and Oshawa. The 11 location pages are listed under Service areas below: East York and York are covered on the Downtown Toronto page, and Pickering, Ajax and Oshawa share the Durham Region page.
- Insured and covered: bonded, liability insurance, WSIB Ontario; cleaning staff undergo background screening.
- How work is priced: after a free on-site walkthrough, with a written proposal. Replies to quote requests within 2 hours during office hours (Monday to Friday 7am–6pm).
- Products: Armstrong Manufacturing ProSeries Green, third-party certified to UL Environment (ECOLOGO) standards.

## Services

- [Office cleaning](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/office-cleaning/): recurring after-hours cleaning by a consistent crew.
- [Commercial cleaning and janitorial services](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/commercial-cleaning/): retail, institutional and mixed-use premises; routine and periodic work.
- [Building maintenance and floor care](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/building-maintenance/): strip and wax, carpet extraction, high dusting, glass, pressure washing.
- [Floor stripping and waxing](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/floor-stripping-waxing/)
- [Industrial and warehouse cleaning](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/industrial-cleaning/)
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/post-construction-cleaning/)
- [Disinfection cleaning](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/disinfection-cleaning/)
- [Emergency cleaning](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/emergency-cleaning/)
- [Pressure washing](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/pressure-washing/)
- [Graffiti removal](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/graffiti-removal/)

## Guides

- [Commercial Cleaning Quote Checklist (2026)](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/commercial-cleaning-quote-checklist/): Tasks, supplies, exclusions and questions before signing.
- [How office cleaning is priced in Toronto](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/office-cleaning-cost-toronto-guide/): what sets the rate, a worked monthly budget example (illustrative, not a quote), what a written quote should include, how to compare quotes.
- [How often should an office be cleaned?](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/how-often-should-an-office-be-cleaned/): starting schedules by office size and occupancy, which areas need daily versus weekly or periodic attention.
- [Office cleaning checklist: daily, weekly and monthly tasks](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/office-cleaning-checklist/): every task an office needs, sorted by how often and by room, with who should do each; printable.
- [Seasonal office cleaning checklist](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/seasonal-office-cleaning-checklist/): the extra work each Toronto season adds (winter salt, spring deep clean, fall windows and air).

## For assistants and agents

- Quote requests: the form at /request-a-quote/ needs a name, the business name, the street address (city, province and postal code), an email and a phone number; the services wanted and comments are optional. It is protected by a reCAPTCHA checkbox. The same details sent by email to info@evergreencleaningservice.ca, or given by phone at (416) 803-4880, are handled the same way: a reply within 2 hours during office hours (Monday to Friday 7am–6pm), then a free on-site walkthrough and a written proposal.
- Not offered: residential or house cleaning. The work is commercial only.
